'''''Delicacies from the Demon Moon''''' was a [[Book/Legends|cookbook]] by [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Napo Popotis]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the period of [[Sith Wars/Legends|conflicts]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Dissatisfied with typical [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonian]] cuisine, which was made from tough game and often bland, Popotis was inspired by the sight of a group of [[drexl]]s attacking a supply [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and tearing through bags of powdered goods.<ref name="Cookbook" />

As a result, he began [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of experimentation to create flavorful [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] derived from the creatures of Onderon's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. Popotis catalogued his new recipes in a cookbook that was published under the title ''Delicacies from the Demon Moon'', which became a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] bestseller.<ref name="Cookbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Delicacies from the Demon Moon'' is mentioned in the Codex entry of the same name in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']], a [[2019]] Digital Expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Cookbook" />
